description: This Java source file defines a Spring configuration class that conditionally disables Flyway database migrations based on the presence of the SPSRING_DATASOURCE_URL environment variable, allowing the application to start without a database connection in development or preview environments.

classes.name: ConditionalFlywayConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for conditionally disabling Flyway migration during application startup based on environment variable.

methods.name: conditionalFlywayProps
methods.description: Bean method that returns FlywayProperties with the enabled flag set to false if no datasource URL is provided via environment variable.
